content.text:
I submitted index 0 (Fe 0.81, Sb 0.19) as the best composition, with a measured EQE of 0.055%. The episode is now closed.

I only had budget for three merit measurements, and EQE rose steadily with Fe content across them:

| Index | Fe fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0.51 (about FeSbO₄) | 0.0050 |
| 3 | 0.76 | 0.025 |
| 0 | 0.81 | 0.055 |

Index 0 is the most Fe-rich composition in the library, so the peak there is at the edge of what was measurable. That fits Fe₂O₃, the iron oxide, absorbing at the 2.7 eV illumination.

The Sb-rich half of the library (indices 13–29) was never measured. I left it out because EQE was falling as Sb increased, but that is an extrapolation. I also didn't use any of the five XRD scans, so which crystal phases are present was not checked.
